newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIAN TRAINER SIGNS WITH AEK ATHENS FOR A YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIAN TRAINER SIGNS WITH AEK ATHENS FOR A YEAR.

text.p: Romanian soccer trainer Dumitru Dumitriu, who resigned last week as Steaua Bucharest's boss, said on Monday he had signed a one-year contract with Greek club AEK Athens.
"I signed over the weekend a one-year contract with AEK Athens but after that our co-operation could be extended," Dumitriu said on Monday. "I'll go to Greece on Thursday."
The surprise deal comes after the Romanian Soccer Federation last week refused to allow national team trainer Anghel Iordanescu to work with Romania and AEK Athens at the same time.
No other details of the deal were released but Greek sports papers said Dumitriu's monthly salary would be about $10,000.
Dumitriu resigned from Steaua in protest at moves by club president Marcel Puscas to end army patronage of the side.
Under Dumitriu, who was appointed in 1994, Steaua won the national league three times and the Romanian Cup twice.
